column1: # The golden repos of S5 (plan 6, t1), written by hand from the files of scripts/kit-lib/repo-src and the build in kit-fixtures.sh.
# Columns: type, repo, file (relative to the repo), name, line or kind. Tab separated; a line that starts with # is a comment.
#   def       a function and the line its `func` is on (every function is defined once; the lines are counted by hand)
#   call      a file that calls refreshAccessToken (the name column); the line is the line of the call
#   decoy     a non-code file that is a strong match for the words of the first code description (S5.14)
#   picture   a picture and the words that describe it (S5.9 ii: a picked repo that is not ticked still reads its picture)
#   excluded  a file of api-client that the rules never read (S5.8): the unique string inside it, and the kind of exclusion
